items.title: Despite no Luka Dončić, the Lakers never trailed against the Pistons, winning 121-116. Austin Reaves had 43 points, his fourth-highest-scoring game ever. Ziaire Williams had 17 points, and Jarred Vanderbilt grabbed 10 boards in his 14 minutes. LA will take on Atlanta tomorrow.
items.author: Edwin Garcia
items.body_excerpt: Despite no Luka Dončić, the Lakers never trailed against the Pistons, winning 121-116. Austin Reaves had 43 points, his fourth-highest-scoring game ever. Ziaire Williams had 17 points, and Jarred Vanderbilt grabbed 10 boards in his 14 minutes. LA will take on Atlanta tomorrow.

items.title: What an impressive quarter by LA with Luka out. They lead the Pistons 38-14 after one. Grimes got the start and is taking advantage, with a team-high 10 points. Austin Reaves has 8 points. Ziaire Williams scored 8 points off the bench, and Vandro grabbed 6 boards in 5 minutes.
